# Fast mode

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

Fast mode provides synchronous translation for individual text inputs. The response returns immediately after translation completes.

## Capabilities

-   Single-call plain text translation
-   Immediate translation results
-   Optimized for short text, chat messages, UI strings, and notes

Fast mode supports one target language per request. The API returns a map of translated text keyed by target language code.

The source and target can be any two supported languages. English doesn't have to be the source or target language.

## Input

The API accepts the following input:

-   Plain text with a maximum input length of 4,000 characters
-   Chat messages, UI strings, and short notes

## Output

-   Returns `result.translations`, an object keyed by target locale code
-   Maps each target locale code (for example, "es-ES") to its corresponding translated text

## Translation options

These options control the source language and target languages.

Use BCP-47 locale codes for `source_language` and `target_languages` (for example, `"en-US"`, `"es-ES"`). Omit `source_language` to detect the input language automatically.

The API doesn't accept short codes such as `"en"` and `"es"`.

| Parameter          | Type     | Default             | Description                                                                                                 |
| ------------------ | -------- | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `source_language`  | string   | Automatic detection | Optional locale code of the input text (e.g., `"en-US"`). Omit to detect the source language automatically. |
| `target_languages` | string[] | —                   | A single target language locale code (e.g., `["es-ES"]`).                                                   |
| `reference_id`     | string   | —                   | Optional client-supplied identifier for tracking requests.                                                  |

For the full list, see [Supported languages](/docs/ai-services/translator/#supported-languages).

## Text translation

Use this endpoint to send text for synchronous translation:

**`POST /aiservices/translator/translate`**

### Example request (cURL)

This cURL example translates Spanish directly into German.

```shell
curl -X POST https://api.zoom.us/v2/aiservices/translator/translate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "text": "Hola a todos. Bienvenidos a Zoom AI Services.",
    "config": {
      "source_language": "es-ES",
      "target_languages": ["de-DE"]
    },
    "reference_id": "msg_456"
  }'
```

#### Response (200)

```json
{
    "request_id": "3f2b8c1e-7a4d-4e9b-b6f0-1c5d8a2e9b47",
    "result": {
        "translations": {
            "de-DE": "Hallo zusammen. Willkommen bei Zoom AI Services."
        }
    }
}
```
